title: i18n(ko): Add Korean translation for deadlineStatus in dag.json (May 2)
body: Adds Korean translations for the `deadlineStatus` namespace in `airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/public/i18n/locales/ko/dag.json`. | Before | After | | ------- | ----- | | | | | Key | Korean | |-----|--------| | `actual` | 실제 | | `expected` | 예상 | | `finishedEarly` | 데드라인보다 {{duration}} 일찍 완료 | | `finishedLate` | 데드라인보다 {{duration}} 늦게 완료 | | `label` | 데드라인 | | `met` | 달성 | Note: chose "데드라인" over "마감 시간" to match the developer-friendly tone consistent with other untranslated terms (DAG, Task, Trigger) in the UI. Remaining keys (`missed`, `missedCount_*`, `mixedCount`, `stillRunning`, `upcoming`, `upcomingCount_*`) are not yet present in the Korean file and can be added in a follow-up. --- ##### Was generative AI tooling used to co-author this PR? - [X] Yes — Claude Code (Opus 4.7) Generated-by: Claude Code (Opus 4.7) following [the guidelines](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/contributing-docs/05_pull_requests.rst#gen-ai-assisted-contributions)
